modules.name: Verified launch boundary
modules.authorityModel: Only the immutable LBPStrategy address may initialize the one bound pool.
modules.humanSummary: Creates a fixed-supply token through the official factory, sells it through the official auction path, then initializes one precommitted Uniswap v4 pool.
invariants: Only the configured launch strategy can initialize the pool.
The hook cannot be reused for a different pool configuration.
Creation and transfer into the launch path must be atomic.

modules.name: Fixed platform fee
modules.authorityModel: No admin. Anyone may trigger collection, but funds can only reach the immutable fee recipient.
modules.humanSummary: Charges 0.10% of the absolute unspecified amount of each completed swap and accumulates it as PoolManager claims.
invariants: No caller can redirect accrued fees.
The hook does not alter the specified swap amount before execution.

modules.name: Dynamic LP fee
modules.humanSummary: Reserved for a separately audited hook family.
invariants: Must not be presented as compatible with Verified Standard V1.

modules.name: Oracle-aware behavior
modules.humanSummary: Reserved for a separately audited hook family with explicit oracle failure handling.
invariants: Must not be presented as compatible with Verified Standard V1.

modules.name: External custom hook
modules.authorityModel: Defined by the external hook author.
modules.humanSummary: A future permissionless path that must be isolated from verified launches and clearly expose its risk.
invariants: Must never inherit the verified badge.
Must display bytecode, permissions, source verification, audit status and mutable authorities.
Must not be able to impersonate a Launcher-owned hook family.
